segments.text: Assistant purser (AP) on a cruise ship. She is a competent, but ordinary AP who is just performing her normal duties. She happens to learn the secrets and plans of the Planning Section 2, and is targeted as a means to keep her mouth shut. She is forced to be a part of the plan as it is, and he finds herself committing evil deeds with a guilty conscience.
Translated from the game's website
客船のAP（アシスタント・パーサー）。
有能だが、あくまで通常業務を行っているだけの普通のAP。
たまたま企画二課の秘密と計画を知ってしまい、口封じも兼ねてターゲットにされてしまう。
さらにそのまま計画にも加担させられ、良心の呵責に耐えながら自身も悪行に手を染めていく。

She is a so-called “YOWTUBER” who is aiming to become an idol by earning views on the video site YOWTUBE and selling her name. Normally, she is a simple company employee who is starting to think that she is too old to be an idol and that she will have to resort to any means necessary. After acquiring a ticket for the “Uzushio”, Odoru plans to attract the attention of the press, many of whom are on board for the maiden voyage, by making a conspicuous appearance onboard the ship.
Translated from the game's website
動画サイト「YOWTUBE」でアクセス数を稼いで名を売りアイドルを目指す、いわゆるYOWTUBER。
普段はしがない会社員であり、年齢的にもそろそろ真っ当なアイドルは厳しいと考えて手段を選ばなくなりつつある。
「渦潮」のチケットを手に入れた踊は、船内で目立つ行動を取って処女航海で多く乗り込んでいる報道陣の興味を引こうと画策する。

She is a freshman girl attending school. Her father, a leading pharmacological researcher, passed away several years ago due to illness. She lives a normal life with her father's inheritance, but she does not have a lot of assets because a large amount of money was invested in research funds.
She lives alone with her mother, who is tired of dealing with relatives since her father's death, so she entered a lottery for tickets to the Uzushio. She won a pair of tickets.
Delighted with her daughter's happiness, the mother also asked Ruka, who was present at the opening of the winning ticket, “Why don't you come with us?" (the Neyagawa family pays for Ruka's ticket).

Because her father entrusted his daughter with confidential information, she is targeted by a suspicious person hired by a rival in the pharmacy world, and Planning Section 2 sniffs out the information and plans to snatch it from the side. Rio's childhood friend, Ruka, is her confidant and sister.
Translated from the game's website
学院に通う一年女子。
父親は薬学研究の第一人者で、数年前に病気で他界している。
父親の遺産でやりくりしているが、多額の費用を研究資金に投入していたためそれほど資産が豊富なわけではなく、ごく普通の生活をしている。
母親と二人暮らしで、父親が亡くなってから親戚との関係などで疲れている母親を元気付けようと考え「渦潮」の乗船券抽選企画に応募。
ペアの乗船券に当選する。
娘の気持ちを喜び、母親は当選通知開封の場にいた流花も「一緒に来ない？」と誘う。
結果、三人で乗船する事になる（流花の分は寝屋川家が支払う）。
父親が機密情報を娘に託しているため薬学界のライバルが雇った怪しい人物などに狙われており、その情報を嗅ぎつけた企画二課がついでとばかりに横から掠め取ろうと画策する。
理央にとって流花は幼馴染であり、親友とも姉とも呼べる存在。

She is a sophomore at Tamano Gakuen. Her parents divorced several years ago, and her father, who took her and her younger sister in, evaporated, leaving her with debts. She is now somehow able to attend the school with the kindness of her relatives and earns her living by working part-time jobs. The Neyagawa family is also concerned about Rio's childhood friend and takes care of her in any way they can.

In order to support her young sister, she wants to work immediately after graduation, so she spares no time to study and learn various skills at her part-time job. She is generally cheerful, good-natured, quick-witted, and considerate, and has a good number of friends. However, due to her family environment, she is not allowed to get too deeply involved in her own affairs, and she tends to have shallow friendships due to her financial problems.

She is positive and quick to make up her mind, and naturally tries hard to do what is beneficial to her. When Rio's maternal grandmother offers to take care of her younger sister while she is away, she feels bad about refusing, so she takes advantage of the Neyagawa family's kindness and comes aboard.
Translated from the game's website
玉乃学園に通う二年女子。
数年前に両親が離婚した挙句、自分と妹を引き取った父親も借金を残して蒸発。
現在は親戚の温情でどうにか学園には通いつつ、バイトの掛け持ちで生計を立てている。
寝屋川家も理央の幼馴染という事で気にかけており、何かと世話を焼いてくれている。
まだ幼い妹を養っていくためにも、卒業後はすぐに就職して働きたいと思っており、そのため寝る間を惜しんで勉学に励みつつ、バイト先で様々な技術を身につけようとしている。
基本的に明朗快活で人当たりが良く、頭の回転も速くて気遣いができるため、友人もそれなりに多い。
ただし家庭環境のせいで自身の事にあまり深くは立ち入らせない上、
金銭的な問題で何かと付き合いも悪いため浅い友人関係になりがちで、実質理央が最も歳の近い友人となっている。
前向きで割り切りの早いタイプであり、自身の得になる事には無意識に向上心が働いて自然と頑張ってしまう性格。
理央の母方の祖母が妹の面倒を留守中見てくれるという事で、断るのも悪いと考え寝屋川一家の好意に甘えて乗船する。

A spy sent by Pacific Cruises, an overseas shipping company that was merged into Skull's Sea Line. She originally worked for an agency, but resents being transferred overseas after the merger, and is cooperating with the former executives of Pacific Cruises. She is investigating the source of funds for Skull's Sea Line and information that could undermine the company's upper management.

She also comes aboard to discover the secret behind the design of the revolutionary “Whirlpool,” which is said to have been created by the company's shipbuilding department. Takako sneaks into the off-limits section and is caught by the protagonist, only to be subjected to a terrifying experience.
Translated from the game's website
「スクルズ・シー・ライン」に吸収合併された海外の海運会社「パシフィック・クルーズ」から送り込まれたスパイ。
元々は代理店勤務だったが、吸収合併で海外転勤になった事を恨んでおり、元「パシフィック・クルーズ」の幹部らに協力している。
「スクルズ・シー・ライン」の資金源や上層部の足元を掬う情報がないか調査しており、さらに同社の造船部門が生み出したとされる画期的な「渦潮」の設計の秘密を探るため乗船する。
立ち入り禁止区画に潜り込んだ孝子は主人公に捕まり、恐ろしい目に遭うことに。

The section chief of the Second Planning Section, he was instrumental in the establishment of the new SSL and the campaign. Planning Section 2 is responsible for the behind-the-scenes work of 【SSL】and is also the execution unit that implements the plan. Therefore, he has a great deal of power that goes beyond his position, and even the head of the division has a hard time keeping his head above water.

Because the luxury liner is huge and offers a wide range of services, it has a larger crew than most cruise ships, and Takehito is the general manager who oversees the entire crew in addition to the captain. His main task is to select a few passengers and take them to a secret island owned by SSL. While performing his duties on board, he is also involved in the abduction and training of passengers.
Translated from the game's website
「SSL」の新設に辣腕を振るい、今回のキャンペーンを立ち上げた影の功労者である企画二課の課長。
企画二課は「SSL」の裏の仕事を担っており、計画を行う実行部隊でもある。
そのため役職を超える大きな権力を有しており、事業部部長も頭が上がらない存在。
巨大でサービスが多岐に渡る豪華客船のため、乗務員は一般的な客船に比べても多く、武人は船長とは別にそのすべてを束ねる総合主任として乗り込んでいる。
乗客の中から数名を選抜して「SSL」が保有する秘密の孤島に連れ込むのが最大の仕事。
船内の業務を行いながら、乗客の拉致と調教をこなすべく暗躍する。
Captain of the luxury cruise ship Uzushio.
